label: D1 after an unrewarded trial while the policy leans toward a1
explanation: Reset-gate unit almost entirely at D1 (95% of mass; small weak tail at GO, never at D2), and nearly only when the reward input is 0, i.e. the previous trial was unrewarded (97% of mass). Within that, it is selective for the agent leaning toward a1: the upcoming choice is a1 (90% of mass) and the model policy logit(a1)-logit(a2) is strongly positive. D1 & prev_reward==0 alone has mass recall 0.95 but precision 0.33; adding upcoming action==1 (future, but the agent computes it) gives F1 0.62; using the observed policy logit choice>4 instead gives dev P 0.79 / R 0.60 / F1 0.69 / mass 0.83, which I recorded since it uses only the model own state. It is enriched after rare-unrewarded a1 trials (go back to a1) and when S1 is the good state, and fires more late in the episode (trials 50-89). It does not fire after rewarded trials or on any D2 step. The missed activations are weak and mostly at GO or at D1 with a smaller a1 lean.
